about_short_description.short_description: Drowzy offers an extensive range of fashion, furniture & home accessories that are practical, trendy and affordable products.

product.name: Furniture
product.description: Items including TV units, side tables, coffee tables, shelving units, armchairs, sofas, and pouffes designed for home use.

product.name: Cushions
product.description: Various types of cushions including cotton, corduroy, handwoven, leather, and light cushions for sofas and chairs.

product.name: Home Accessories
product.description: Decorative items including vases, accents, wall hangings, and sculptures for home decoration.

product.name: Mats & Rugs
product.description: Floor coverings including rugs and mats in various sizes and patterns for home use.

product.name: Serve & Dine Products
product.description: Serving and dining items including trays, platters, bowls, cups, containers, glassware, and wooden stands for food presentation and dining.
